    Profile

    Logi is a Squire of Envylia's most powerful knight faction, the Blue Flame Guard. The Blue Flame Guard's Captain, Zeke Crowley is his father. Though he's proud to be the son of the Blue Flame Guard's Captain, part of him longs for peace, and this may make him a little too tender-hearted...

    Origin: Envylia
    Gender: Male
    Height: 171cm
    Weight: 60kg
    Birthday: Jan 11
    Blood Type: Type Ki
    Zodiac: Moon of the Bright Knight
    Likes: Agatha's homemade stew
    Hobbies: Looking up at the sky with nothing to do
    Illust: RINZO
    CV: 花江夏樹
